gameplay.title: Solitude
gameplay.author: The Firefly
gameplay.excerpt: A single patient glow waits at the center of the ruined ring.
gameplay.body:
This is a place for solitude. You are alone here.

The pillars keep their distance so the sky can speak without interruption.
